description: 6 x 600m intervals at 5k pace (or recovery pace) with a 60-second recovery between intervals, followed by 6 x 60m strides at a Fun Fast or recovery pace.
400-meter down Cheesman Park at a controlled 10k pace, followed by 400-meter back up Cheesman at marathon pace. Take a 90-120 second recovery between intervals.
Club social run, relaxed, social run open to all levels and abilities.
